_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
Smart Cuff v3.2.112 (Valinor)

Improves recorder shutdown, recording clock metadata, pressure-gap messages,
and pulse-versus-baseline diagnostics. Immediate protocol commands are batched
within a bounded timer tick while acknowledgement and serial pacing remain.
Native pressure/flow/voltage samples, calibration and firmware are preserved.

Firmware remainsrev27v-gauge-42. Experimental319 controller research is not bundled.
